name: q26-options
description: Q26 Options — options analytics & paper-trading platform (option chain, OI, IV, strategy builder, optimizer, backtest).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @q26/server" "npm run dev -w @q26/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @q26/web && npm run build -w @q26/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @q26/core && npm run test -w @q26/server && npm run test -w @q26/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @q26/core && npm run typecheck -w @q26/server && npm run typecheck -w @q26/web
